$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. A bank card (debit, Girocard): the old profile's bank-card, a card core with no security code. A security code on one is an unknown attribute, reported under the catalog's policy.
title: Bank card
description: A bank card (debit, Girocard): its number, holder, issuer and PIN.

cardholder.description: The name printed on the card.

issuer.description: The bank that issued the card.

issuer_phone.description: The issuer's phone number, for example the blocking hotline.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid: here, the card's expiry day. Empty means it does not expire.

allOf.description: A card has an expiry date.
